text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober overcame her first three years—

She is now hailed by many
as a "new dawn of glory."

However, she had no intention
of remaining seated there.

Seeking a new self that surpasses who she is now,
her brilliant trajectory will continue on—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh... Dober...!
That was... so sharp...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like I can't really act like
the big sister anymore, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Tandem run's over!
...I'm heading to the gym."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We can't let the 'New Mejiro'
steal all the spotlight, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, have you just wrapped things up?
Well, isn't that nice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then, Dober, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes... M-Me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's a message for you—from my sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! From Ramonu-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To Dober, the "New Mejiro."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Saying, "Let us meet on the turf someday."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...I truly am a fortunate one~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Bright?
...What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
――Because Dober was my peer, because she was my comrade in arms,
I've been able to work hard together with her all the way up to today~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It suddenly struck me...
just how happy of a thing that is~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's... the same for me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because Bright was with me,
I was able to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Together, we can continue to reach for even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed it is~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Our path... our new trajectory is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And so, our story will continue~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Still, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The one who walked closest by your side all this time
wasn't me, was it~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Come to think of it, I have some business to attend to after this~.
I will take my leave now~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Please give my best regards
to your Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"……I'm all packed up.
Bright said she had some errands to run, so she went on ahead."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You know, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do you think of me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no!
That's not what I meant at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, no way!?
That's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I didn't mean it like that—
How do I say this, anyway!
What I really wanted to say was, like—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I didn't mean it like that—
No, wait, what I meant was...! How do I put it, just now was—

What do I think of Mejiro Dober?
That's something that hasn't changed from the very beginning.
choice_data_list: Strong, hardworking, and never giving up—

text_block_list.text: "Facing herself more than anyone, continually searching for who she is more than anyone, and proud of who she is more than anyone—"
choice_data_list: To me, you're the strongest Uma Musume in the world.
To me, you're the strongest Uma Musume in the world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...In that case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, the day after, and every day after that, endlessly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Keep watching me, always, as my strong self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Keep telling me I'm 'strong.' Always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You can do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sounds good, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Because Trainer is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Because Trainer is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Closer to me than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Because they were always right there beside me.
